title: Crumb Session Handle (crumb.handle v1)
description: What an agent gets back from `crumb launch`: a running, already-logged-in browser it can drive over the Chrome DevTools Protocol. Contains no cookie values.

pid.description: PID of the supervisor process that owns the browser. Stopping it saves the session and closes the browser.

http.description: CDP HTTP endpoint, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:53211 — pass to Playwright `connectOverCDP`, Playwright MCP `--cdp-endpoint`, Chrome DevTools MCP `--browserUrl`, browser-use `cdp_url`.
